verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented funnel analytics for Stripe Identity: no pass-rate, drop-off, or completion-time reporting broken down by country or document type. The verification-session API and status events are only developer building blocks a founder could use to build such analytics, not the capability itself. The 'conversion-optimized flow' claim describes UX, not reporting.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see verification funnel analytics — pass rates, drop-off points, completion time by country and document type — to know what verification is costing me in signups
